# TruthGate v1.1.0 — Repository Documentation for Agents

TruthGate audits LLM agent responses against cited RAG source documents and workspace AST symbols deterministically in `0.128 ms` P50 (`P95 = 0.347 ms`) with zero external core dependencies.

## Guides
- Getting Started: `docs/GETTING_STARTED.md`
- MCP & HTTP Server: `docs/MCP_AND_HTTP_SERVER.md`
- Website: https://codesphere-u.github.io/truthgate/

## Verification Rules (`TG001`–`TG008`)
- `TG001` Phantom Source Citation (`CRITICAL`)
- `TG002` Low Lexical/Entity Support (`HIGH`)
- `TG003` Negation Polarity Inversion (`CRITICAL`)
- `TG004` Numeric & Magnitude Drift (`CRITICAL`)
- `TG005` Uncited Factual Assertion (`MEDIUM`)
- `TG006` Non-Existent File Path (`CRITICAL`)
- `TG007` Out-of-Bounds Line Range (`HIGH`)
- `TG008` Phantom Code Symbol (`CRITICAL`)
